# Assessment Overview

This directory contains the supplementary architecture and repository-analysis documents generated for the assessment report.

1. [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application layers and detailed component relationships.
2. [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) — Declared external libraries grouped by functional category.
3. [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — Endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and service contract summary.
4. [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, inferred entity model, and persistence boundaries.
5. [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, environment overrides, and sensitive settings inventory.
6. [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) — Primary workflows, business rules, and workflow sequence.
